**Authors:** R. E. Lopez (Rice University, Houston, TX) and J. W. Freeman (Rice University, Houston, TX)

In summary, the authors analyze Helios 1 data to find an experimental fit for the proton temperature-velocity relationship at 1 AU. They report that the relationship changes at about 500 km/s. They find that interplanetary processes such as stream interactions affect the relationship by less than 22 percent, and that its functional form appears to hold throughout the solar cycle. They conclude that any comprehensive solar wind model must account for the difference in this relationship between low- and high-speed wind.
